The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $4.48 (Tranche 1), $4.2 (Tranche 2), and $3.88 (Tranche 3).
